data.name: Filiberto
data.long_meaning: The name Filiberto is derived from the Latin word 'filius' meaning 'son' and 'berto' meaning 'bright, shining, strong'. This name was commonly given to sons born into noble families. It was also a popular name among the early Christians, symbolizing the brightness and strength of faith.
